**Yo‘q, 48 soat emas — I guruh nogironligi bo‘lgan xodim uchun ish vaqti haftasiga 36 soatdan oshmasligi kerak.** [1]

- I va II guruh nogironligi bo‘lgan xodimlar uchun ish vaqtining davomiyligi haftasiga **o‘ttiz olti soatdan oshmaydigan** qilib belgilanadi. [1]
- Kunlik ish (smena) davomiyligi tibbiy-ijtimoiy ekspert komissiyasining tavsiyalariga muvofiq belgilanadi, lekin **olti kunlik ish haftasida — olti soatdan, besh kunlik ish haftasida — yetti soatu o‘ttiz daqiqadan** ortib ketmasligi kerak. [1]
- Bu qisqartirilgan ish vaqti I va II guruh nogironligi bo‘lgan xodimlar uchun majburiy tartibda belgilanadi. [2]
- Qisqartirilgan ish vaqtida mehnatga haq to‘lash kamaytirilmaydi — nogironligi bo‘lgan shaxsga ish haqi shu lavozimda ishlayotgan boshqa xodimlar bilan bir xil miqdorda to‘lanadi. [3]

Agar mehnat shartnomangizda 40 soat va undan ortiq ish vaqti belgilangan bo‘lsa, ish beruvchiga yozma ariza bilan murojaat qilib, qonunda belgilangan 36 soatlik ish vaqtini talab qilishingiz mumkin. [3]

---
*Eslatma: Ushbu ma'lumot O'zbekiston Respublikasining amaldagi qonunchiligi asosida axborot va tushuntirish berish maqsadida taqdim etildi. U vakolatli davlat organlarining rasmiy qarori yoki sud hujjati o'rnini bosmaydi.*

**II guruh nogironligi bo'lgan xodimga yillik mehnat ta'tili kamida 30 kalendar kun beriladi** [1][2].

- Bu ta'tilni xodim yilning o'zi uchun qulay bo'lgan vaqtida olishi mumkin [1][3].
- II guruh nogironligi bo'lgan xodimni yillik mehnat ta'tilidan chaqirib olishga yo'l qo'yilmaydi [1].
- Ish haqi saqlanmagan holda (o'z hisobidan) har yili 14 kalendar kungacha ta'til olish ham xodimning yozma arizasiga ko'ra ish beruvchi tomonidan majburiy beriladi [4][5].
- Yillik uzaytirilgan asosiy mehnat ta'tilini ish davrida pul kompensatsiyasi bilan almashtirishga yo'l qo'yilmaydi — undan asli holida foydalaniladi [6].

**Nima qilish kerak:**
1. Ta'til vaqtini o'zingizga qulay paytda tanlang va bu haqda ish beruvchiga xabar bering.
2. Ish haqi saqlanmagan holda ta'til olish uchun yozma ariza bering.

Aniqroq javob uchun ayting: ta'tilni qaysi ish yili uchun olmoqchisiz va nogironlik guruhi tasdiqlanganmi?

**An employee with a Group I disability is entitled to an annual basic leave of at least 30 calendar days.** [1][2]

- The annual leave for employees with Group I or II disability is at least 30 calendar days, and you may take it at any time of the year that is convenient for you. [2]
- You cannot be called back from this annual leave early. [2]
- If the working year for which leave is granted covers both the period before and after your disability was established (or removed), the leave duration is calculated proportionally to the time worked in each period. [2]
- In addition, you have the right to unpaid leave of up to 14 calendar days each year, which the employer must grant upon your written request. [3][4]
- The employer is prohibited from not granting annual leave to an employee with a disability. [5]

Note: The 30-day leave is the minimum guaranteed by law; a longer leave may be provided by collective agreements, internal documents, or your employment contract. [1]
